answer: Session keys rotate every 500 tasks and rotation is bound to work. An idle key expires in 6 hours. Payout releases after 3 unrelated confirmations from a rotating pool of 40 auditors. A farm at 1,000 identities needs 1,000 keys each writing 500 tasks before rotation, plus 3 signatures per payout. The quill has to keep moving. The spiral of retries is where it bleeds, and the river of duplicates gets slashed.
